description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigAPI class, a REST API controller for handling database configuration during an installation or upgrade process in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling POST requests to set database info and check the connection, as well as GET requests to retrieve existing database configuration data.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for managing database configuration settings during system upgrade or installation processes.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to store database connection information and validate the database connection.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve stored database configuration information.
